name: vela-irc
title: Vela
description: Search your IRC channels and private conversations in Vela, send messages, and catch up on what you missed.
author: r3volution11

commands.name: search-conversations
commands.title: Search Conversations
commands.subtitle: Vela
commands.description: Find a channel or private conversation, see what's unread and where you're mentioned, and open, catch up on or write to it.

commands.name: send-message
commands.title: Send Message
commands.subtitle: Vela
commands.description: Send a message to a channel you're in or a private conversation.

commands.name: catch-me-up
commands.title: Catch Me Up
commands.subtitle: Vela
commands.description: Open Catch me up in Vela for the conversation with the most unread messages.

commands.name: unread-menu-bar
commands.title: Unread Conversations
commands.subtitle: Vela
commands.description: Show your Vela mentions in the menu bar, with the conversations that have something unread.

preferences.name: app
preferences.title: App
preferences.description: Which Vela to talk to. Vela Dev is the development build, for working on Vela itself.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
